visual_enhancers.shadows: Restrained, crisp shadows. Use shadow-sm for cards, shadow-md for floating panels.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E7E5E4 (light) or #44403C (dark) for clear separation. No muddy glassmorphism.
visual_enhancers.radii: rounded-lg for standard components, rounded-full for badges and pills.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use flat solid surfaces. Avoid glassmorphism to maintain maximum clarity and trust.

hero_input.description: Goal-first large input field with voice mic button, text submit, and an 'I'm not sure' secondary CTA.

journey_tracker.description: Deterministic 6-stage timeline (Understand → Confirm → Eligibility → Documents → Procedure → Application).

copilot_panel.description: Global chat interface handling intent, retrieval, clarification, and guidance.
copilot_panel.layout: Fixed side panel or floating dock (w-80/96, h-[calc(100vh-4rem)]), solid background (no transparent overlays).

document_upload.description: Drag-and-drop zone integrated into the Documents stage.
document_upload.styling: border-2 border-dashed border-stone-300 dark:border-stone-600 rounded-xl p-8 text-center bg-stone-50 dark:bg-stone-800/50
document_upload.features: File preview cards with clear 'Remove' and 'Replace' actions.

life_situation_cards.description: Discovery cards (Starting college, Turning 18, Moving house, etc.)

header.features: Solid background, Logo, MySevaPath link, Compact language switcher (EN/HI/TA), Settings trigger.
header.styling: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-background border-b border-border

badges.description: Trust badges and application mode badges (online/offline/hybrid/unavailable) with 'Why am I seeing this?' tooltips.

layouts.general: Mobile-first, standard header + main + footer. Main content should have generous padding (p-6 to p-12).
layouts.hero: Asymmetric left-aligned content. Avoid generic centered text.

motion.general: Professional and restrained. 200ms ease-out for hover states.
motion.reduce_motion: Respect user settings from the Settings page (toggle for reduced motion).
motion.voice_states: idle (mic icon) / listening (subtle pulse) / processing (spinner) / error / unsupported.

accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44px (min-h-[44px] or h-12) for all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG 2.1 AA compliance for text on backgrounds.

media.guidance: Use calm, minimal abstract textures for background enhancements to convey a modern, humane SaaS feel without resorting to cliché stock photos.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React (.js/.jsx) files, not TypeScript.
Implement global font imports (Chivo and IBM Plex Sans) in index.css.
Do NOT use generic templates or pure Tailwind default colors (like blue-500). Use the defined custom colors (Terracotta primary, Stone/Sand neutral base) for a 'human but official' vibe.
Always apply 'data-testid' to buttons, inputs, and clickable cards using kebab-case role-based names (e.g., data-testid='voice-input-btn').
Ensure the Header has a solid background (no transparent headers) to maintain legibility when scrolling.
Implement the Settings page with functional context/state for Text Size (scaling rem units), Reduce Motion, and Theme.
Avoid glassmorphism; use solid background colors for dropdowns and floating elements to maximize trust and accessibility.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts and simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (unless reduce motion is enabled) - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Ensure dynamic component scaling based on the user's text size preference.
